title: Economists at Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan report the AI boom contributed "basically zero" to US economic growth in 2025, challenging claims of up to 92% growth (Shira Ovide/Washington Post)
summary: Shira Ovide / Washington Post: Economists at Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan report the AI boom contributed “basically zero” to US economic growth in 2025, challenging claims of up to 92% growth — Massive investment in AI contributed “basically zero” to U.S. economic growth last year, Goldman Sachs has calculated.
contentText:
Shira Ovide / Washington Post :

Economists at Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan report the AI boom contributed “basically zero” to US economic growth in 2025, challenging claims of up to 92% growth   —  Massive investment in AI contributed “basically zero” to U.S. economic growth last year, Goldman Sachs has calculated.
